definitions: Born into a wealthy family or privileged circumstances.
Having an easy life due to inherited wealth or status.
examples: She was born with a golden spoon in her mouth, never having to worry about money.
He acts like he was born with a golden spoon in his mouth, completely out of touch with reality.
lemma: born with a golden spoon in one's mouth
synonyms: born with a silver spoon in one's mouth
source: born with a golden spoon in one's mouth
